title: MRI Left Knee Joint and MRI Left Shoulder
headline: The MRI reports show a likely partial tear in your left knee and a tear in your left shoulder, along with some fluid and cysts.
summary: The MRI of your left knee indicates a likely partial tear in the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and a likely Grade II meniscal injury in the medial meniscus. There is also a very minimal amount of fluid in the pre-patellar bursa. The MRI of your left shoulder shows a tear in the superior labrum and subchondral cysts near the humerus. Other parts of both joints appear normal.
